IEEE_730.title: IEEE 730 (Software Quality Assurance)
IEEE_730.description: Yazılım kalite güvencesi planlaması ve süreç denetimi için IEEE standardı.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.placeholder: State the purpose of this Software Quality Assurance Plan (SQAP). Define what product or project it covers and what quality objectives it aims to achieve.

sections.title: 2. Reference Documents
sections.placeholder: List all documents referenced in this plan (e.g., SRS, project plan, relevant IEEE standards such as IEEE 829, IEEE 1028).

sections.title: 3. Software Quality Assurance Management
sections.placeholder: Describe the SQA organization, roles, and responsibilities. Who is accountable for quality activities? How is SQA integrated into the project lifecycle?

sections.title: 4. Documentation
sections.placeholder: List all project documents that are subject to SQA review (e.g., SRS, design documents, test plans). Specify the review criteria for each.

sections.title: 5. Standards, Practices & Conventions
sections.placeholder: Enumerate the coding standards, naming conventions, design practices, and process guidelines that the project must follow. Reference any applicable IEEE or ISO standards.

sections.title: 6. Software Reviews & Audits
sections.placeholder: Identify all planned reviews (e.g., requirements review, design review, code review) and audits. Specify timing, participants, entry/exit criteria, and expected outputs.

sections.title: 7. Testing
sections.placeholder: Describe the testing approach: unit, integration, system, acceptance. Reference the test plan and define criteria for test completion and success.

sections.title: 8. Problem Reporting & Corrective Action
sections.placeholder: Define the process for identifying, documenting, tracking, and resolving defects or non-conformances. Specify the tool or form used for problem reports.

sections.title: 9. Tools, Techniques & Methodologies
sections.placeholder: List the tools used to support SQA activities (e.g., static analysis tools, test automation frameworks, version control systems).

sections.title: 10. Risk Management
sections.placeholder: Identify quality-related risks and their mitigation strategies. Include likelihood, impact, and contingency plans for each identified risk.
